item.title: Cozy Builder
item.description:
Title: Cozy Builder
Genre: Casual , Indie
Developer: Pangea Game Studios
Publisher: indie.io
Release Date: Oct 14, 2026




About This Game

Welcome to Cozy Builder , a relaxing sandbox builder set among rolling hills and sun-dappled vineyards. Design your dream château from modular architectural pieces, decorate every detail inside and out, and bring the valley back to life as you harvest grapes and craft artisanal wine blends in your own countryside retreat.

After enduring an earthquake, the once-bustling Vineyard Valley now rests in quiet disrepair. Restore its beauty, rebuild its homes, and bring warmth and life back to the countryside. Each home you bring back to life helps the valley bloom again, turning forgotten places into reflections of peace and care.

Build from the ground up using intricate, customizable pieces. Create ivy-covered walls, elegant arches, and gabled rooftops that reflect your personal style. Whether you dream of a rustic cottage or a grand estate, every home in Cozy Builder tells its own story.

Furnish interiors with art, cozy furniture, and handcrafted details that make your spaces feel alive. Step outside to design gardens, terraces, and greenhouses bursting with flowers and greenery. Every decoration adds warmth and charm to your vineyard retreat.

With abundant sunshine across the valley, no home is complete without a greenhouse. Create elegant glass structures filled with light, color, and life, seamlessly connected to your home interiors. Collect rare plants, nurture flowers, and design lush indoor gardens that blur the line between inside and out. Your greenhouse is both a sanctuary and a living work of art.

Bask in the sunlight as you walk through rolling vineyards surrounded by gentle hills and golden light. Harvest ripe grapes, olives, and other produce nurtured by the valley’s rich soil. Ferment, blend, and bottle your own artisanal wines!

The valley is abundant with life. Gather heirloom produce, forage for herbs and wildflowers, and craft artisanal blends, preserves, and rustic goods to share with the townsfolk or sell to fund your next creation. Each harvest connects you more deeply to the valley you’ve helped revive.

Step inside your château in immersive 3D and enjoy the peaceful life you’ve built. Explore scenic hills, unwind under the warm vineyard sun, and find joy in every detail of your creation. Cozy Builder is a relaxing, creative escape for players who love to design, decorate, and bring beauty to the world.

item.title: over the hill
item.description:
Title: over the hill
Genre: Adventure , Casual , Indie , Racing , Simulation , Sports
Developer: Funselektor Labs Inc.
Publisher: Funselektor Labs Inc.
Release Date: Oct 14, 2026




About This Game

Explore, navigate, and uncover the vast wilderness of over the hill, the newest installation from the creator of art of rally. Ramble your way through varied biomes inspired by real-world locations, from valleys to mountains and everything in between.

Take to the trails solo or with up to three friends. Cruise through scenic landscapes, tackle challenging off-road routes, and work together to overcome the obstacles standing between you and your destination.

Different situations call for different solutions. Use planks to cross gaps, deploy winches to recover vehicles and navigate difficult terrain, and bring the right equipment to help you overcome the challenges ahead. Whether you're carefully planning your route or improvising your way through a tricky situation, the journey is always in your hands.

Explore forests, lakesides, and mountains as you uncover remote cabins, scenic viewpoints, natural landmarks, meteorites that have fallen from the sky, and portals that can take you to new areas. Dynamic weather and day/night cycles can transform the world around you and change the conditions of your journey.

Spot native wildlife and use the in-game camera to document your discoveries. Photograph the animals you encounter to fill out your wildlife compendium, or stop to capture an awe-inspiring landscape, a beautiful sunset, or any other moment worth remembering.

Find upgrades and equipment throughout the world to help you take on the terrain ahead. Stop at merchants and cabins to customize your vehicle with colours, accessories, and cosmetics that suit your driving style.

This is a driving game, not a racing game. Take your time, enjoy the drive, find your own route, and see where the road leads. The best stories never start at the end.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
item.description:
Title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
Genre: Action , Indie
Developer: Auroch Digital
Publisher: Big Fan Games , Devolver Digital
Franchise: Warhammer
Release Date: Oct 14, 2026




About This Game

Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is the brutal and fast-paced sequel to boomer shooter Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun.

Following directly on from the end of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, your duty takes you to new locations in a branching, single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grim, and dark Warhammer 40,000 universe with a fast-paced first-person shooter.



Lock in as one of two playable characters, each offering their own unique abilities, weapons, and play style.

Dominate combat as the unrelenting force that is Malum Caedo, a formidable Sternguard Veteran with a reputation for purging heretics. Or quickly take control of the battlefield as the swift and nimble Sister of Battle Celestian, Nyra Veyrath, torching enemies and leaving only ashes in her wake.




Take the fight to never-before-seen worlds and vanquish the foes that lurk there. From the colossal heights of a hive city to the impenetrable mangrove swamps of a jungle, and even to the heart of the Ark of Omen… You’ll need to overcome the challenges of each location to complete your mission.



Built on the explosive combat of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, charge headfirst into glorious battle armed with an arsenal of deadly weapons. Shred enemies with your lethal chainsword, blast them into an explosion of pixels and blood with your Shotgun or set them aflame with a torrent of liquid fire from your Flamer!



As your arsenal improves, so do the enemies! Eviscerate enemies from the four Chaos god factions (Nurgle, Tzeentch, Khorne, and Slaanesh) in glorious, visceral fashion. The ferocious Bloodletters and their daemonic Juggernauts are a near unstoppable force as they charge into battle hungry for blood! While Daemonettes gracefully leap around the battlefield between the Noise Marines and their devastating sonic weaponry.

Features

  • Two Playable Characters – Play as the formidable Malum Caedo or battle-hardened Nyra Veyrath, each with their own playstyle.
  • Explosive FPS Gameplay – Obliterate foes in high-octane combat.
  • Branching Campaign – Choose your own path through the campaign with each branch featuring unique levels.
  • NEW Enemies – Face never-before-seen foes from different factions.
  • NEW Weapons – Eviscerate hordes of relentless heretical scum with devastating weapons.
  • NEW Locations – Discover a range of worlds and biomes.
  • Navigation Tools (Optional) – Effortlessly maneuver across the battlefield with the navigation guide and automap so you’re always at the center of the combat.
  • Mick Gordon Guest Track – Annihilate the final boss to the sound of Mick’s sick riffs.
  • AND MORE!

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 contains scenes involving violence, blood and gore.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 x64 Bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce GTX 980 (4096MB) / Radeon R9 Fury (4096MB) / Arc A580
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 13 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Low Quality setting, in 1080p, producing 60 FPS
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 x64 Bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650 (4096 MB) / Radeon RX 570 (4096 MB)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 13 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: High Quality setting, in 1080p, producing 60 FPS

item.title: Ratatan
item.description:
Title: Ratatan
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , Indie , RPG
Developer: TVT Co. Ltd. , Ratata Arts
Publisher: Game Source Entertainment
Release Date: Oct 14, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 18, 2025




About This Game

Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players.

An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee.

Defeat the enemies by riding the rhythm of Ratatan’s catchy, toe-tapping soundtrack in this delightful, heartfelt adventure!

Welcome to Rataport!

In the vast and tranquil sea, there is an island as lively as a toy box. The name is "Rataport" On the island, a strange animal-like creature called Ratatan lives happily with their friends. Despite their different appearances and personalities, they share a common dream. Which is go to “The Everafter". And meet "The Goddess" who is said to live in there. As heroes who carry the hope of all, the Ratatans embark on a journey to The Everafter. No matter how many times they failed, they will never give up and dreamt of meeting her one day.

Rhythm action

Feel the beat and use rhythm sequences in time to order your Cobuns in the direction you want them to go.

Since the Ratatans can be moved freely, your judgement to decide where to give orders, where to position the ratatan, and when to retreat is critical.

2D animation

We want to emphasize the unique performance of 2D animation and put lively personality into the action.

item.title: The Witch's Bakery
item.description:
Title: The Witch's Bakery
Genre: Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: Sunny Lab
Publisher: Silver Lining Interactive
Release Date: Oct 14, 2026




About This Game

The Witch's Bakery is a cozy narrative Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris . She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal their emotions through magic!

YOUR DAILY LIFE AS A WITCH-BAKER IN PARIS!

You play as Lunne, who has just arrived in the city! Each day is split into three phases:

  • Daytime , where Lunne works in the bakery and helps customers through their troubles with a little magic.

  • Evening , where Lunne explores Paris, builds relationships, discovers the city's secrets and goes inside her friends' troubled hearts.

  • Night , where Lunne rests, improves her magic, decorates her bakery and spends time in her cosy atelier.

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

A COLORFUL PARIS IN A JOYFUL ADVENTURE!

Once your work day is done, you can visit several districts of Paris to meet with main characters , engage in activities to get to know them , buy books for new recipes , etc.

The above example is "Le Quai des Bouquinistes" located in the 6th arrondissement of Paris! This place is known for its book sellers and its collectors of various entertainment goods, like vinyls, posters, old magazines... But also, of course, for the beautiful Notre-Dame.

Each district has its own characters, activities and shops!

A STORY ABOUT EMOTIONS AND VULNERABILITY

For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace" , a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape . Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the Heart's Cradle .

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them !

ABOUT SUNNY LAB

We are an indie team of experienced developers from France ! We have gathered to create hopeful stories , filled with lovable characters, happy smiles and deep emotional journeys . We are always reachable on our socials @SunnyLabGames!

We are so happy to share our first game "The Witch's Bakery" with you! We are still at the beginning of production and we'll be sharing all our progress with you! Feel free to ask us any question!

THE WITCH'S BAKERY DISCORD SERVER

Join our community of bakers on The Witch's Bakery Discord! It’s the best place to find all the latest news regarding the game and where you can find a community of likeminded people to chat to. You can find the link to join the server in the FAQ pinned in the Steam Discussions page!
